description: This file defines a Perl module for managing FAQ entries within an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, and updating FAQs, utilizing a web framework with chained actions and model interactions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::FAQ
classes.description: Controller class for managing FAQ entries in the admin section, extending the base controller and providing actions for CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list all FAQs, adding URLs for editing each FAQ and a link to create a new FAQ.

methods.name: new_faq
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new FAQ, setting URLs for form submission and navigation.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method that loads a specific FAQ by ID and stores it in the stash, or detaches with a not found error.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific FAQ, setting URLs for form submission and navigation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing FAQ, delegating to the update_or_create method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new FAQ, initializing a new FAQ object and delegating to update_or_create.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Private method that sets FAQ columns from request parameters, updates or inserts the FAQ, and redirects to the edit page.
